verdict.rationale: The API/MCP tools show some batch-like features (fireflies_move_meeting up to 5 meetings, fireflies_share_meeting up to 100 recipients, transcripts query filterable by an array of emails) but these are capped, narrow operations rather than general bulk actions across arbitrary large item sets. missing for 10: evidence of true bulk create/update/delete across unlimited items, batch mutation endpoints, or documented large-scale automation workflows beyond these small-capacity tools.
